plain: In 1982 a former CIA officer named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen had a dream of the year 2060 in which he travelled with UFOs out of an underground CIA base, in a world already in apocalypse after "the great nuclear war of 2034." Mowatt-Larssen, who tells Michels he considers himself a kind of time traveller, says he remembers the year 2060 specifically and that he was going "back and forth" in the dream. If it were a true glimpse ahead, it would foretell a nuclear war within the next decade.
